conclusion: The October 17 Orca main integration remains historical. Ten of the eleven snapshots in its prior performance-scope record are still byte-identical. SupportCommon.cpp now adds complete organic contours and preserves direction-locked walls through height modulation; the previous snapshot matches checkout HEAD and the entire declared delta has been reviewed. Current generic support verification passes 127 native cases and 21017 assertions, plus two actual Release exports with 54221 matched closed outer contours and no bearing failures. The old large-project speed/output identities, GUI/macOS and remote observations retain their original dates and anchors. The current support repair changes support paths and material cost; it does not establish a new upstream integration or renew the old performance claims.
scope: Current source-contract audit of the declared organic-support delta, bound to its reviewed normal Release evidence. Historical integration/runtime observations stay historical. No fresh upstream fetch, GUI/macOS audit or remote-ref verification is claimed. Source bindings refreshed after the 2026-10-22 support-gap correction and Release reslice verification.
